def _applications(self, entry_module, entry_env):
    apps = []
    queue = deque([(entry_module, entry_env)])
    while queue:
        module, parent_env = queue.popleft()
        for pipe in self.pipes_by_target.get(module.name, ()):
            target_module = self.modules[pipe.filter]
            app = Application(target_module, parent_env, pipe.bind, self.compiler)
            apps.append(app)
            queue.append((target_module, app.env))
    return apps
```

def _declarations(self, order):
    out = []; seen = set(); done = set()
    def walk(t):
        if isinstance(t, Alias):
            key = ('a', t.name)
            if id(t) in done: return
            walk(t.type)
            if t.name not in seen: seen.add(t.name); out.append(t.name)
            done.add(id(t))
        elif isinstance(t, Struct):
            if id(t) in done: return
            for f in t.fields.values(): walk(f)
            if t.name not in seen: seen.add(t.name); out.append(t.name)
            done.add(id(t))
        elif isinstance(t, Enum):
            if t.name not in seen: seen.add(t.name); out.append(t.name)
            done.add(id(t))
        elif isinstance(t, Array):
            walk(t.element_type)
    for name in order:
        m = self.modules[name]
        for (pname, ptype) in m.params: walk(ptype)
        walk(m.result_type)   # void → nothing
    return out
```
